Commentary.Commentary: As for the bowling, all of the South African bowlers hit their straps from last evening itself. Olivier got three and Rabada picked up four wickets, Maharaj and debutant Mulder had one each whereas Dale Steyn was the only one who went wicketless. The lead of 68 runs is going to be more than handy on this track and South Africans will look to come and bat Sri Lanka out of this game. Meanwhile, the visitors will have to try and pick early wickets in the hosts' second innings. We will be back in a bit for a short period of play before Lunch...

Such a disappointing morning for Sri Lanka! After the manner they bowled on Day 1, they have absolutely shown no intent to bat long here. They just went for their shots, got quick runs but also lost a lot of wickets and have been bowled out in the process. After beginning the day at 60/3, the away team lost a wicket in the very third over and the procession began from there on. Duanne Olivier and Kagiso Rabada removed the middle order together and put the visitors in a position where getting a lead was almost out of question and getting close to 222 was their motive. Kusal Perera, Dhananjaya de Silva and Niroshan Dickwella all came and played their shots and made quick runs but none went on to make anything significant. Thus, the Lankans ended up conceding a lead of 68 runs.

OUT! GONE! Short of a length delivery outside off, Dickwella makes room and looks to play an upper cut but gets it off the lower portion and it goes in the air behind the slip cordon. Elgar from third slip runs back and takes a good catch. A good innings by Dickwella comes to an end. So that is the end of the Sri Lankan innings as Lasith Embuldeniya will not come out to bat. SRI LANKA FINISH AT 154/9.
Bowls a yorker just outside off, Dickwella makes room and looks to drive but misses it.
Short of a length delivery, Dickwella looks to pull but gets hit on the shoulder. It goes towards first slip.
Good length delivery on off, Dickwella defends it off the front foot.
Vishwa Fernando walks in at number 10. He will be the last batsman to the crease as Embuldeniya won't be able to bat. Also, Kagiso Rabada is back on.

OUT! Three reds and Lakmal has to walk back, he takes a review along with him. Did not see that coming though. With the angle, it looked like it would just about be clipping but Hawk Eye shows differently. South Africa won't care though. After two tossed up delivery, Maharaj bowls it flatter and lands it on middle. Lakmal goes back to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal follows and the umpire raises his finger. Lakmal reviews. Replays show that the on-field call is the right one. A handy stand for Lanka comes to an end.

Review time... Suranga Lakmal has been judged LBW here by the umpire but he has gone upstairs. Looked like it could be just clipping the leg stump to the naked eye. Let's see whether the replays feel the same...
Just like this one! Similar to the last ball, Lakmal lunges and keeps it out.
BEATEN! Slower through the air on middle, it pitches and turns square. Goes past Lakmal's outside edge. Should have probably played ahead to this delivery.
Swept and nicely but just for a run to deep square leg.
On the shorter side, Lakmal goes back and whips it through mid-wicket. Takes a run.
Tosses it up on middle, Lakmal blocks it out.
Good length delivery on off, Dickwella looks to play inside the line but misses it.
FOUR! 150 up for Sri Lanka. Nice improvisation from Niroshan. Length delivery on middle, Dickwella plays a scoop over the keeper for a boundary.
Bowls a bouncer, Dickwella does well to duck under it.
BEATEN! Good length delivery on middle, Dickwella looks to play the scoop but misses it.
Short delivery on middle, Dickwella pulls it through mid-wicket. The batsmen get two runs.
Good length delivery outside off, Dickwella lets it go.
Wiaan Mulder is back into the attack. A change of ends for him.
The batsman has edged that one. They manage to come back for the second.
Short on off, Lakmal cuts it to point.
Flighted delivery on off, Suranga defends it off the front foot.
Short delivery, Dickwella pulls it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up on off, Dickwella looks to play the reverse sweep but gets beaten on this one.
FOUR! Floated on middle and leg, Dickwella sweeps it towards fine leg. It goes towards the fielder there. Rabada dives and tries to stop it but it goes past him to the fence.
Keshav Maharaj is into the attack.
FOUR! Good shot. Full on off, Lakmal drives it straight through mid off for a boundary. 11 runs came from it.
On off, Suranga defends it off the front foot.
Good length delivery outside off, Lakmal looks to defend but gets beaten due to the away swing on this one.
Length delivery on off, the keeper-batsman plays it towards point for a run.
FOUR! Nice shot. Short and outside off, Dickwella cuts it through point for a boundary.
Short and outside off, Dickwella cuts it through point. The batsmen pick up a couple.

APPEAL FOR LBW! NOT OUT! Good length delivery on middle and leg, Lakmal looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. The bowler appeals but the umpire shakes his head. South Africa think abput the review and decide against it. Replays show that it was missing the stumps.
Length delivery on middle, Lakmal flicks it to the leg side.
Full on off, Lakmal defends it out.
Suranga Lakmal is the new man in.

OUT! MAIDEN TEST WICKET FOR MULDER. 9 deliveries is all it took him to do so. A top nut also. It is a good length delivery on off, which means the batsman has to play at it. The ball however seams away, takes the outside edge and goes towards de Kock who takes a comfortable catch. South Africa into the bowlers now.
On middle, de Silva defends it off the back foot.
Good length delivery on off, de Silva defends it off the front foot.
Dickwella is beaten thrice in this over. Good length delivery outside off, Niroshan looks to defend but gets beaten on this one.
Good length delivery outside off, Dickwella looks to defend but gets beaten due to the movement on this one.
On off, Dickwella defends it off the back foot.
Good length delivery outside off, Dickwella looks to pull but gets beaten due to the away movement on this one.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries from Niroshan. Good length delivery on off, Dickwella makes room and plays an upper cut over slips towards third man for a boundary.
FOUR! Poor start from Steyn. Bowls short and outside off, Dickwella cuts it through point for a boundary. Sri Lanka trail below 100 runs.
Dale Steyn is on.
Bowls a yorker on middle, de Silva manages to dig it out. End of a good over from the debutant Wiaan Mulder. He starts with a maiden.
Good length delivery again on middle, de Silva keeps it out.
Outside off, de Silva shoulders his arms to this one.
Again on a good length on off, de Silva defends it off the back foot.
Good length delivery on middle, Dhananjaya pushes it to mid-wicket.
Good length delivery on off, de Silva defends it off the back foot.

On the pads, it is worked through square leg for a run.
Gets bat to another one as it is worked through mid-wicket for a single.
On the off pole, Dickwella gets right behind the line and keeps it out. He finally gets bat to one ball in this over.
Now bangs it short and it is on the body of the batsman. Dickwella ducks but then at the very end looks to pull. Does not connect.
Gets this one to come back in! Shorter in length and on middle, it jags back in. Beats the inside edge of Dickwella's bat and hits him on the thigh pad and goes to first slip.

Lovely bowling! From over the wicket, bowls it full and takes it away from the left-hander. Dickwella is drawn into the drive, he goes after it without any foot movement. Luckily for him though, gets beaten.
FOUR! Nice shot. Full on off, Silva drives it straight past the bowler through mid off for a boundary. Big over for Sri Lanka. 16 runs came from it.
Length delivery on off, Niroshan plays it towards point for a run.
Bowls a bouncer, Dickwella does well to duck under it.
NO BALL! Olivier oversteps! Short of a length delivery, the keeper-batsman pulls it to mid-wicket.

SIX! Good shot from Niroshan. Short of a length delivery, Dickwella pulls it over fine leg for a maximum. Rabada dives and tries to stop the ball but it is very wide of him. It went flat so the umpires want to check whether the ball carried over the rope or not. The replays show that it has gone over the ropes.
FOUR! Nice shot. Full on middle and leg, Dickwella drives it through mid on for a boundary.
Bowls a bumper, Dickwella does well to duck under it.
Outside off, Silva lets it go. End of a successful over for South Africa.
Good length delivery on off, Silva looks to defend but gets hit on the thigh pad.
Short of a length delivery, Silva pulls it through mid-wicket. The batsmen get two runs. 100 up for Lanka.
Good length delivery on off, Dickwella looks to defend but gets an outside edge towards gully. The batsmen cross ends.
Full on off, Dickwella drives it through mid off. The batsmen pick up a couple.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Rabada gets his third, and second of the morning. No heroics from Perera this time and Lanka slip further. Good length delivery outside off, Perera looks to defend but gets an outside edge due to the shape away on this one. It goes to Quinton de Kock who takes an easy catch.

FOUR! Third of the over! This time off an edge, an educated edge though as my colleague says. De Silva was in full control there as he opened the face of the bat and got a thick edge that ran all along the ground between third slip and gully towards the third man boundary.
Kept out watchfully off a good length on top of off stump.
FOUR! Another amazing shot from de Silva! Short of a length outside off and Dhananjaya pulls it away through square leg for a boundary. Meeting fire with fire here these two batsmen.
Defended from the crease on this occasion by the right-hander.
FOUR! Goes really full this time on the middle stump line, flicked away through mid-wicket for a boundary. Really good balance on that one by Dhananjaya.

Edged and just short!!! South Africa almost had their third one this morning. Brilliant ball on a length outside off and swinging away. de Silva looked to defend but the ball takes the edge and goes towards third slip but falls short of Elgar.
SIX! THAT IS OUT OF THE GROUND! Length delivery on off, Perera lofts this over extra cover for a biggie. It almost went into the roof. Big over for Sri Lanka. 14 runs came from it.
FOUR! Good shot. Good length delivery on off, Perera looks to drive but gets an outside edge. It goes towards third man for a boundary.
Length delivery outside off, Perera pushes it to covers. Good fielding by Temba Bavuma.
Full on middle, Perera drives it to mid on.
Good comeback by Rabada. It was bowled on a good length outside off, Perera looks to defend but gets beaten by the movement on this one.
FOUR! Nice shot by Kusal. Full and outside off, Perera drives it beautifully through covers for a boundary.
Bowls the surprise yorker, de Silva gets his bat down in time and keeps it out. End of another testing over by Olivier.
BEATEN! Lovely delivery! Length ball around off, it pitches and straightens. De Silva ends up playing inside the line and gets beaten. Olivier has his tails up here.
One of his rare fuller deliveries, de Silva is upto the mark as he strokes it to mid on.
Now follows the boundary with a single as it is tucked around the corner.
FOUR! Slashed and a boundary! Outside off, Perera throws his hands at it, it flies outside edge through point for a boundary. First boundary today.
Back of a length on middle, Perera keeps it out.
A bumper to welcome the new batsman, de Silva ducks under it.
Dhananjaya de Silva strides out to the middle.

OUT! One brings two and the nightwatchman does not last for long today. All of a sudden, Sri Lanka have half their  side back in the hut. A brilliant delivery this. Good length delivery on off, Rajitha looks to defend but misses the line completely and gets bowled. The ball swings slightly away and it was too good for the nightwatchman to keep out. In trouble are the Lankans, they trail by another 156 runs.
Another play and a miss! Good length delivery outside off, Rajitha looks to defend but gets beaten on this one.
Length delivery on off, Perera plays it towards covers for a run.
Full on off, Rajitha drives it towards mid off for a run.
BEATEN! Good length delivery outside off, Rajitha looks to defend but misses it due to the away movement on this one.
Good nut to end the over! This pitches on off and skids through. It also angles away. Perera looks to defend but is beaten by the away angle. Top over by Olivier, a wicket-maiden.
Goes a touch fuller and on middle, KP gets right behind the line and keeps it out.
Another bouncer, this time Kusal ducks under it.

Ouch! That has hit him and he looks in a little pain. Good short ball to welcome the centurion of the last game. It is a rib-tickler. Perera fails to get bat on it and is hit there. He takes a breather and now is fine to continue.
Kusal Perera, the hero of the last Test, walks out to the middle. Sri Lanka will want him to repeat his feat of the last game.

OUT! A wicket in the third over of the day! Olivier has struck and it is in the form of a good return catch. Good length delivery on middle, Thirimanne looks to drive but while playing the shot, the bat turns in his hands. As a result, it goes of the bottom blade back to Olivier. The good thing from the bowler is that he does not take a big followthrough to his left, which normally fast bowlers do. Hence, he does not have to move much to his right. Still, it was a very nice catch. The umpires check for the no ball but the replays show that he is fine on that count. So Thirimanne's fifty rut continues.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Thirimanne flicks it through mid-wicket. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Good length delivery on off, Rajitha looks to defend but it was a nasty delivery from Rabada. He manages to defends it and the ball dies down.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Thirimanne flicks it towards square leg for a run.
Good length delivery on off, Thirimanne defends it off the front foot.
Third consecutive leave from Lahiru. Outside off, Thirimanne shoulders his arms to this one.
Again on a good length outside off, Thirimanne easily lets it go.
Good length delivery outside off, Thirimanne leaves it alone.
Kagiso Rabada to bowl from the other end.
Plays the four balls well. Good length delivery on off, Rajitha defends it off the back foot. Just a run from the first over of the day.
Good length delivery on off, Rajitha looks to defend but gets an outside edge which goes along the ground towards gully.
Outside off, Rajitha leaves it alone.
Good length delivery on off, Rajitha keeps it out. He negotiates the first ball nicely.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Thirimanne flicks it towards square leg for a run. First run of the day. Olivier now has 4 balls to bowl at the nightwatchman.
Starts with a shortish delivery, Thirimanne looks to duck but the ball hits him on the body and goes to the keeper.

We are all set to begin. The players and umpires are out in the middle. Lahiru Thirimanne and Kasun Rajitha are out in the middle for Sri Lanka. Duanne Olivier will start the proceedings for South Africa.

Welcome to Day 2 of this second Test between South Africa and Sri Lanka. A fast-paced Day One saw 13 wickets go down and the game pretty evenly poised at the end. As for who will be the happier side, it is hard to say. One though will reckon that a few quick wickets this morning and the hosts will consider themselves to be in the driver's seat. The pitch, which is on the slower side, is still offering some assistance to the bowlers who are bending their back. Sri Lanka, on the other hand, will look to bat long. Their main hopes will be Lahiru Thirimanne and Kusal Perera. They have got a blow in the form of a very serious thumb injury to youngster Lasith Embuldeniya, who is ruled out of action for a long time. They are sure to miss his bowling but they might also rue that his antics down the order will not be available. Can they manage without him or will the Proteas turn on the heat in what is expected to be another riveting day of Test cricket? Let's wait and watch...
... Day 2, Session 1 ...

Thus, the game is evenly poised. The away team though should be very happy with how things have panned out. They will need a good innings from one or two of their batsmen which will help them get closer to the total of the hosts, unlike the first Test where they passed up an opportunity to get a first innings lead. Sri Lanka will not look any farther than the first match's hero, Kusal Perera. What will happen on Day 2? Will the hosts run through the middle order or will the Island nation pile up runs and pressure on the Proteas? Only time will tell, join us for the coverage of Day 2. It will begin at 1000 Local (0800 GMT). Till then, take care and cheers!

It was an action-packed Day 1 as 13 wickets fell. The day started with the hosts straightaway on the back foot losing 3 early wickets. Aiden Markram and Faf du Plessis then stitched together a 58-run stand. The Proteas skipper soon departed and Markram was joined by Quinton de Kock. Markram got to his fifty but couldn't last long. De Kock continued his good form and his 86 runs took the South African total to a respectable 222. Vishwa Fernando and Kasun Rajitha were the pick of the bowlers picking up 3 wickets each. Dhananjaya de Silva scalped 2 wickets, including the key wicket of de Kock.

South Africa have bounced back in this one. They have managed to pick up 3 wickets in the 20 overs that they bowled and after one stage where it looked like Sri Lanka had a stronghold on this game, now the hosts have put up their hand for some share as well. The home side needed early wickets and after the Sri Lankan openers started resiliently, Rabada got the breakthrough and ended the 25-run opening stand. Oshada Fernando didn't last long and was soon dismissed. Kusal Mendis was looking good in the middle but right at the stroke of Stumps he was sent back by Duanne Olivier. Lahiru Thirimanne was joined by nightwatchman Kasun Rajitha for the final over. They managed to see off the day and will resume the batting on Friday.

Good length delivery on off, Rajitha plays it back towards the bowler and nearly gives a catch to Steyn. It fell just short of him. THAT IS STUMPS ON DAY 1. SRI LANKA ARE 60/3. THE VISITORS TRAIL BY 162 RUNS.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Thirimanne flicks it towards square leg for a run. Rajitha will face the last ball of the day.
Good length delivery on off, Thirimanne defends it off the back foot.
Good length delivery outside off, Lahiru leaves it alone.
Outside off, Thirimanne shoulders his arms to this one.
Good length delivery on off, Thirimanne defends it off the front foot.
Nightwatchman Kasun Rajitha comes in at number 4 to see off the day.

OUT! Sri Lanka lose their third wicket. Finally Olivier gets his man. After beating the outside edge several times Duanne eventually finds it and sends Kusal Mendis packing. Good length delivery outside off, Mendis looks to defend but gets an outside edge due to the slight away movement on this one. It goes to Quinton de Kock who takes the catch comfortably. Replays show that there was a clear nick when the ball passed the bat.
Good length delivery outside off, Kusal looks to defend but gets beaten due to the away movement on this one.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Mendis flicks it through square leg. The batsmen pick up a couple.
BEATEN! Good length delivery outside off, Mendis looks to defend but misses it. There was good shape on this one.
FOUR! Nice straight drive from Kusal. Full on middle, Mendis drives it straight past the bowler for a boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, Mendis leaves it alone.
NO BALL! Olivier oversteps! Short of a length delivery, Mendis pulls it to mid-wicket.
Outside off, Thirimanne does not disturb the ball on its way to the keeper.
Length delivery on off, the ball goes away after pitching. Lahiru looks to defend but gets beaten by the away swing.
FOUR! That is a good shot from Lahiru. Back of a length delivery around off, Thirimanne rocks onto his back foot and punches it through cover-point for a boundary.
Length delivery on off and middle Thirimanne defends it off his back foot.
Good length delivery on middle and off, it comes back in after pitching. Lahiru looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pad.

Again an edge falls short of the fielder. Back of a length delivery around off. It rises onto the batsman. Thirimanne looks to play it on the off side but gets a thick outside edge. The ball falls short of the diving gully fielder and goes behind towards the third man region. Thirimanne gets a couple.
Good length delivery on middle, Mendis defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! Nice shot from Kusal. Short and outside off, Mendis cuts it through point for a boundary.

It was a surprise delivery by Olivier. Good length delivery on off, Mendis looks to cut but gets a glove due to the extra bounce on this one. It goes towards third slip where Bavuma runs to reach to the ball but it fell short of him.
FOUR! Good shot. Length delivery on middle and leg, Mendis flicks it past short leg and it goes through square leg for a boundary.
Length delivery on off, Thirimanne defends it towards point and takes a quick run.
Good length delivery on off, Thirimanne looks to defend but gets an outside edge towards slips. It fell short of the fielder.
Again on a good length on off, Kusal looks to defend but gets an outside edge towards point. The batsmen get two runs.
Good length delivery on off, Mendis looks to defend but gets an outside edge towards gully.
Good length delivery outside off, Mendis shoulders his arms to this one.
On off, Thirimanne defends it towards point and takes a quick run.
Good length delivery on off, Thirimanne defends it off the back foot.
Good length delivery on the stumps, Lahiru defends it off the back foot.

The bat seemed to have come down a little late from Fernando. It goes onto the top of middle stump. South Africa seem pumped up now and not too worried about the loss of the review.
Short of a length outside off, cut away towards deep point for a single.
Length ball on the pads, flicked towards the mid-wicket region.
Peach! A fuller length ball outside off and Thirimanne is coaxed into a drive. The ball though just beats the outside edge and goes to the keeper.
Left alone outside off and from a length by Thirimanne.
Left alone outside off by Oshado.
This one keeps low! A length ball on off and Fernando is on his back foot to keep this out but the ball goes below the bat. The line is outside off so the batsman is safe.

Nothing, absolutely nothing there. Good length delivery on off, the ball swings away just a bit after pitching. Fernando looks to push it on the off side but misses. De Kock goes up in appeal so does all of the slip cordon. Rabada appeals but does not seem so sure. Du Plessis consults with the keeper and takes it upstairs. The replays shows there was nothing on Snicko and South Africa lose their review. A real waste of a review here by the Proteas, it looked not out to the naked eye.

Review time... Du Plessis has taken this one upstairs. Loud appeal from the bowler and keeper for caught behind but the batsman seems unmoved and pretty confident. Let's see what the replays have to say.
Fuller in length on the stumps, Fernando defends it off his front foot.
Good length delivery outside off, Fernando looks to push it but gets beaten and the ball goes past his outside edge.
Good length delivery on off, Oshada defends it with a straight bat.
Kept out watchfully towards the bowler.

Well outside off, the LT misses his drive.

FOUR! Good timing that! A short length ball on top of middle, just guided away through the point region for a boundary.
A length ball on top of middle, pushed back towards the bowler by Thirimanne.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Ferenando defends it towardas mid-wicket.

Drinks have been taken. South Africa have finally managed to break this opening stand after almost 12 overs. They will look for more wickets. Meanwhile, Oshado Fernando walks in at number 3.

OUT! Rabada finally gets the better of Karunaratne's defense. Good length delivery on off, the ball goes away slightly after pitching. Dimuth looks to push and gets a thick outside edge. Rabada has just and I mean just by a thin air has his heel behind and the skipper walks back. Kagiso gets his man on this occasion but needs to be careful.

Good length delivery pitching on off and middle, the ball jags back in and hits Dimuth on the mid-riff region beating his defensive bat.
Shorter in length on middle and leg, Dimuth ducks underneath it.
Left alone outside off by Thirimanne.
In the air... but drops well short. A short of a length ball on middle, Thirimanne looks to defend the ball but gets a glove and the ball lobs towards the point region but does not carry.
Length ball outside off, fended off towards the off side.
A short of a length ball on middle, kept out by Lahiru as he rides the bounce.
Defended off the back foot by the southpaw.
Starts off with a length delivery on middle and it moves away from the left-hander. Thirimanne leaves it alone.

Almost! A length ball outside off and Dimuth looks to play at the ball. It moves a bit and just whizzes ever so closely past the edge.
